limitations: Some parameters are corroborated by original launch/transfer/reference scripts rather than by the exact historical execution log; confidence distinguishes them.

No best parameter is inferred solely from a current launcher default. Folder labels are stored only as provisional inference in all_candidates; selected rows include result/config and cross-source evidence.

Runtime checkpoints, data versions, exact sample-ID alignment and all preprocessing/source revisions were not universally recorded. Equal n/frames/budget is necessary but insufficient to prove matched inputs.
Current merge_score_mode=full is the unablated algorithm target, but not all historical logs print a mode. Unknown values remain null rather than fabricating execution evidence.
Legacy log_count and no-correction records are not mixed in the main ranking. LookM 3B only has legacy log_count results in the located set; 7B LookM has no result.
The historical 7B Snap .70/.90/2 NextQA result is excluded for a runtime-observed 0.0 ratio/512 history budget despite directory and summary .10 labels.

The scan covered extracted workspace result files, current artifact scripts/logs, tuning subtrees, relevant /root launchers and /tmp launch logs/summaries. It did not exhaustively unpack every historical archive or search external machines.
notes_for_publisher: Publish selected_rows as the main none table and missing cells; publish historical_rows separately. Do not convert missing values to zero or transfer defaults from a different model/dataset.
VATEX scores are raw fractions here: mean4*100 gives the existing display convention.
Keep excluded_rows and same_parameters_repeats visible in provenance; do not describe the excluded 7B Snap fixed512 run as a 10% optimum.
